content_units: Family Movie Night Lineup

A balanced 6-film set that fits kids 8 and 11, two grandparents, and your comfort rules: no horror, very little crude humor, and a combined runtime of about   10 hours 17 minutes  . The mix below includes   3 animated + 3 live-action   films for variety across the week.
6 Crowd-Pleasing Picks
Film   Type   Runtime   Why it works for all ages   Simple snack pairing
Paddington 2   Live action   1h 43m   Warm, funny, gentle, and especially grandparent-friendly   Marmalade sandwiches or orange slices
Toy Story 3   Animation   1h 43m   Smart, heartfelt, and engaging for both kids and adults   Popcorn with mini chocolate chips
The Princess Bride   Live action   1h 38m   Classic adventure-comedy with light romance and quotable humor   Trail mix and grape juice
Kiki’s Delivery Service   Animation   1h 43m   Calm, charming, and easygoing with no scary edge   Chocolate chip cookies and milk
Hidden Figures   Live action   2h 07m   Inspiring, family-appropriate, and excellent for mixed ages   Moon pies or star-shaped cookies
My Neighbor Totoro   Animation   1h 26m   Gentle, cozy, and ideal as a lower-energy family-night pick   Rice crackers or fruit skewers
Total runtime:     10h 20m
That stays comfortably under your   11-hour   limit.
Why These 6 Make the Best Holiday-Week Mix
Option 1:   Paddington 2     The safest all-ages winner here; kind humor and big heart   Best overall family pick

Holiday Week Watch Order
-   Night 1:   Paddington 2 — easy, funny opener
-   Night 2:   Toy Story 3 — energetic and emotional
-   Night 3:   Hidden Figures — the “smart family night” pick
-   Night 4:   Kiki’s Delivery Service — lighter midweek reset
-   Night 5:   The Princess Bride — classic adventure feel
-   Night 6:   My Neighbor Totoro — gentle, cozy finale

Compare ratings

Family-Fit Notes
- I prioritized   gentle tone, broad humor, and low-friction content   over edgy comedy.
- A few picks have mild peril or emotional moments, but none are horror-driven.
- Studio Ghibli titles are especially useful for mixed-age groups because they stay imaginative without loud or crude humor.
